name: type:bug
description: Something shipped does not behave as its spec says

name: type:feature
description: New or changed behaviour of the format, a skill, the agent, the hub, or the website

name: type:task
description: Harness, tooling, documentation, or maintenance work

name: area:format
description: The HARNESS.md specification, its validators, and the conformance fixtures

name: area:plugin
description: skills/, the verifier agent, plugin.json, and client wiring

name: area:hub
description: hub/ entries and the hub entry rules

name: area:site
description: site/ and the GitHub Pages deployment

name: area:harness
description: HARNESS.md, AGENTS.md, knowledge, project skills, scripts, workflows, hooks

name: spec:pending
description: Unarchived OpenSpec change awaiting the maintainer's approval (set by pr-labels)

name: spec:approved
description: Maintainer approved the OpenSpec change at the recorded commit; kept while unchanged

name: spec:archived
description: The OpenSpec change is archived; the pull request may merge (set by pr-labels)

name: spec:skipped
description: Nothing to approve: no change touched, or every change sets skip_specs: true (pr-labels)
